newsitem.title: USA: Measurement sees industrial sensors revs up.
newsitem.headline: Measurement sees industrial sensors revs up.

text.p: Measurement Specialties Inc said on Tuesday it expects revenues in the high margin category of industrial sensors to triple this fiscal year.
The company said it expects to achieve a compounded annual growth rate in revenues of 20 percent a year over the next five years.
The company has a number of tests projects underway in the production of industrial sensors.
Measurement Specialties, however, designated fiscal 1997 as a transition year in which it would bear the costs of the redefined direction.
The company also said it would focus on acquisitions in the sensor business.
Measurement Specialties designs, develops, manufactures and markets a wide-range of low cost sensor-based electronic measurement devices.
